derivation: from (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age);
def: as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much

occurrences.text: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
